title: Weekly email digest notification preferences
purpose: Proposed handoff assembled from source-linked outcomes; human source review and approval required.

scope.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: After a member switches weekly email digests on in notification settings, weekly email digest messages are delivered to that member.
After a member switches weekly email digests off in notification settings, weekly email digest messages stop being delivered to that member.

stories.text: The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: After a member with weekly email digests switched on signs out and signs back in, weekly email digest messages continue to be delivered to that member.
After a member with weekly email digests switched off signs out and signs back in, weekly email digest messages remain stopped for that member.

stories.text: Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
acceptance_criteria: After a member switches weekly email digests off, account-security messages for that member continue to be delivered.

stories.text: A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Immediately after a new member is created, no weekly email digest message is delivered to that member until the member switches weekly email digests on.

open_questions: What specific message types are classified as account-security messages for the guarantee that switching weekly email digests off does not disable them?
What event starts the weekly email digest interval for a member (for example, switching digests on, member creation, sign-in, or a fixed weekly calendar time)?
Is the weekly email digest interval measured as elapsed 7-day periods or calendar weeks, and which time zone determines the week boundary?
What is the exact start and end inclusion boundary of one weekly email digest interval?
What happens after the weekly email digest interval ends for a member whose setting remains on, and what happens when a sign-out/sign-in or setting change occurs during the interval?
How does a member supply the weekly email digest on/off choice in notification settings, how are sign-out and sign-in requests supplied, and how is a new member created?

How should the system respond after the weekly email digest setting is switched, after sign-out/sign-in, and after new member creation, including confirmation and error/exhaustion semantics when the request cannot be completed?
Which user/UI behaviors apply for setting weekly email digests, for sign-out/sign-in persistence, and for new member default behavior under the chosen interface contract?
Who owns the weekly email digest notification preferences work?
What is the delivery date for the weekly email digest notification preferences work?
